description: Aarhus University publishes borehole profiles from the 2017 investigation of its high-plasticity-clay test site at Hinge, Denmark. The March 2024 Zenodo deposit contains two sets of borehole-profile PDFs and a site-plan PDF. These are investigation records, not an article-only deposit, and all three documents are freely available under CC BY 4.0. A modeller can use the logged strata and borehole positions to prepare or compare ground models for foundation and buried-infrastructure simulations in clay. Coverage is this test site and campaign; the public description does not establish borehole count, depth range, coordinate reference, logging conventions or uncertainty. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the Hinge collection. The document format may require careful transcription before numerical use. Only the landing page and inventory were reviewed, so individual profile values and consistency were not checked.
